meters.text: No current official Little Tokyo meter rate found. LADOT's LA Express Park uses demand-based, time-of-day meter pricing in Downtown; a 2013 LA Express Park update extended time-of-day rates to blocks 'primarily in Little Tokyo and the Toy District', with periods Mon-Fri before 11am, 11am-4pm, after 4pm, and Saturday. Rates vary by block; the meter/pay station shows the rate. A 2025 LADOT council report (search snippet only; document moved) proposed a $0.50/hour meter increase by Sept 30, 2025 — unverified. Go Little Tokyo says only 'street parking' is available; JANM says street parking is 'available but limited'. Advise visitors to read the posted meter and signs.
